BackstoryDef.title: wet nurse
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years caring for infants in another household, settlement, or noble estate. [PAWN_pronoun] learned the quiet work of feeding, soothing, cleaning, and watching for the first signs of sickness.

BackstoryDef.title: babysitter
BackstoryDef.description: Before life on the rim, [PAWN_nameDef] watched children for busy families and overworked caretakers. [PAWN_pronoun] learned how to calm arguments, answer endless questions, and keep children safe.

BackstoryDef.title: midwife
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assisted births in previous communities, clinics, and crowded family homes. [PAWN_pronoun] was rarely the most experienced medic present, but [PAWN_pronoun] knew how to stay calm in stressful situations.

BackstoryDef.title: adoptive refugee
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lost [PAWN_possessive] first home to war, disaster, or collapse. Another family took [PAWN_objective] in. It was not the life [PAWN_pronoun] was born to, but it taught [PAWN_objective] that family is not defined by blood.

BackstoryDef.title: foster child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] moved between temporary homes, learning each household's rules just in time to leave again. [PAWN_pronoun] became good at reading adults, remembering what mattered to people, and adapting before anyone needed to explain.
